gary_2026_10_02_fall_founders_day.summary: Gary's Guide: We are hosting Founders Day in NYC. If you are a NYC based founder or CEO, please register to join us. Take a break from your team, get out of your office (or apartment), & come get some work done during a day dedicated to our community. The goal of Founders Day is to bring together people for meals, networking, optional workshops & just spending time with each other. We will have dedicated space, & attendees can enjoy a day to work from the venture law firm, Gunderson Dettmer's space. Agenda: 9:30am Arrive & enjoy breakfast; find a spot to cowork All Day: Legal Office Hours with the Gunderson Dettmer team: Feel free to submit your questions ahead of time & you'll be able to sign up day of for a number of limited spots to speak to the team 1:1 to get your legal questions answered. 12:00pm - 1:00pm Legal Workshop with Gunderson Dettmer -what founders should keep top of mind legally as they grow their companies. 1:00 pm Enjoy lunch 5:00 pm Head out The Gunderson Dettmer team will also be available to answer questions during the day. Please RSVP by Wednesday, 9/30 as we'll send the list to security in advance. More about our sponsor: Gunderson Dettmer is the preeminent international law firm with an exclusive focus on the innovation economy. The firm serves market-leading venture capital & growth equity investors & pioneering companies through inception, growth & maturity, as well as groundbreaking public companies that result from the global venture capital ecosystem. Learn more at https://www.gunder.com/en.

gary_2026_10_02_builders_nyc_dev_talk.title: Builders NYC - Dev Talk
gary_2026_10_02_builders_nyc_dev_talk.label: Tech / AI
gary_2026_10_02_builders_nyc_dev_talk.summary: Gary's Guide: Dev Talk LIVE Come hear what NYC builders are actually working on. Dev Talk LIVE brings together a small lineup of developers, founders, & builders to showcase what they've built, tell the story behind it, & break down the technical & product decisions that got them there. Each featured builder gets the floor to take us inside their project: what they set out to build, the problems they ran into, the technology behind it, what changed along the way, & what they learned from shipping it. gary_2026_10_06_tech_x_market_decoders_l.summary: Gary's Guide: We decode tech & market signals together, salon-style with a curated group - so you can operate, invest, & decide better. Past attendees have been founders, investors & operators who work in tech or tech-adjacent roles across industries - Our Why AI can build a financial model, summarize an earnings call, or map a competitive landscape in seconds. What AI cannot do is connect the dots around what's happening right now - a technology, a trend, a business, an idea, a decision. Or what a moment like that actually signals. That takes human judgment, experience, & taste. The kind you only build by studying real examples, arguing them out loud, & testing your read against people who see it differently than you do. If you want a space to actually grow your thinking IRL & connect with people who match that energy, this is it. That's what Tech x Market Decoders is for. Every week, we pick one topic - a company or startup everyone's talking about, a technology reshaping an industry, or a shift in how things are being built or bought. Bring your laptop. Here's how it works: Check-in & Intros 15 minutes - decode solo. Quick research time. Dig into the news, the product, the tech, the data. 45 minutes - decode together. We open the floor. What did you find? Where do you disagree? What's convincing, what's overhyped, what would change your mind? This is where judgment actually gets built - not from reading alone, but from testing your read against someone else's. Last few minutes - wrap up. You'll leave with a sharper read on the topic than you walked in with, & a few new perspectives you hadn't considered. That's the whole point. This week's topic: Let's Talk About Jev! A tiny AI startup called Jev just went viral for doing the opposite of what every other AI company is doing - it doesn't chat at all. Built by an ex-OpenAI researcher, Jev only returns fast, structured decisions (yes/no, multiple choice, confidence scores) instead of generating text, & it's reportedly fielding funding offers north of $10 billion just over a week after launch. We're decoding: Is Jev a genuinely new category of AI - a faster, cheaper layer sitting underneath the chatbots - or is this hype-cycle enthusiasm for something that's really just a narrow classifier with good marketing? Supporting questions: Does the "specialized model" approach threaten the big general-purpose LLMs, or complement them? What would it take for Jev's $10B valuation talk to actually make sense a year from now? Come as you are - operator, investor, builder, or just someone who reads too much tech or business news & wants to discuss with smart people. Prep not required but feel free to do some home research before you arrive if you'd like. **Refunds available up to 48 hours before the session. gary_2026_10_07_pmai_creativity_business.title: PMAI - Creativity & Business Problems In Age Of AI

gary_2026_10_07_pmai_creativity_business.summary: Gary's Guide: Creativity & Business Problems in the Age of AI - a workshop for entrepreneurs We are entering a strange moment for creativity. For decades, we have been taught that innovation comes from thinking outside the box, brainstorming more ideas, & waiting for that breakthrough moment. But in the age of AI, & ideas are suddenly abundant, the real challenge is no longer simply coming up with more ideas. It is knowing how to find the right pieces, make unexpected connections, & turn them into something genuinely new & useful. This hands-on workshop, led by our head of program Jeffrey, introduces a practical methodology for doing exactly that. What we'll cover We'll start by looking at some of the traditional assumptions behind creativity & innovation: brainstorming, originality, intuition, & the idea of the lone creative genius, & why some of those assumptions are becoming less useful in an AI-native world. We'll then introduce a different way to approach creative problem-solving: instead of trying to invent the answer from scratch, you'll learn how to break a problem apart, deliberately search for useful precedents & ideas, & recombine existing elements in new ways. Through real-world case studies, we'll examine how successful products, businesses, & innovations often emerge not from a completely original idea, but from making the right connection between things that already exist. Most importantly, this will not be a lecture. You'll work through the methodology yourself, apply it to actual business problems, & leave with a framework you can reuse when thinking about products, positioning, growth, operations, or your next startup idea. Who should attend This workshop is designed primarily for: Early-stage founders, aspiring entrepreneurs, small business owners, product builders, & operators who regularly need to solve ambiguous problems with limited resources. No technical background is required. If you have ever stared at a blank page thinking, I need a better idea, this workshop is for you. Come with a problem. Leave with a different way of thinking about it.

jc_culture_44040_2026_10_03_free_diapers.summary: Please Take Our Ad: Community Giving Luvs is bringing its Give Back Billboard to Jersey City, turning an advertisement into an opportunity to directly support local families with free diapers. From 12–6 p.m., families can visit Mary McLeod Bethune Park and take part in an interactive billboard made from Luvs diaper packs. As the packs are removed, the billboard will gradually reveal the message: “Leak protection shouldn’t be a luxury.” For 50 years, Luvs has stood for value, and as families face the rising cost of raising children, the brand is bringing that commitment directly to the community through free diapers, giveaways and more. One free box of diapers per household, while supplies last. Sizes subject to availability. No purchase necessary.

jc_culture_10004834_2026_10_03_rent_the_.place: ART HOUSE, 345 MARIN BLVD, JERSEY CITY
jc_culture_10004834_2026_10_03_rent_the_.summary: Experience the groundbreaking Tony Award-winning musical and Pulitzer Prize-winning drama that defined a generation. Presented at Art House Productions during the 30th anniversary year of its original premiere, RENT follows a vibrant community of artists, musicians, and dreamers in New York City’s East Village as they pursue their passions, navigate love and loss, and strive to make a meaningful impact on the world around them. Set against the backdrop of the AIDS crisis, poverty, addiction, economic uncertainty, and a rapidly changing city, these artists discover the power of friendship, the importance of creative expression, and the enduring strength of community. Featuring iconic songs and an unforgettable rock score, RENT celebrates resilience, human connection, and the transformative role of the arts in times of hardship. This production is especially meaningful as part of Art House Productions’ 25th Anniversary Season. Founded in the wake of September 11, 2001, Art House was created to bring people together through the arts during a time of profound loss and uncertainty. Thirty years after its premiere, RENT remains as relevant, timeless, and inspiring as ever, reminding us all to measure our lives in love.

jc_culture_10003571_2026_10_07_hamilton_.summary: Join us at the Hamilton Park Farmers Market, your midweek destination for fresh, local, and thoughtfully crafted food and goods. Each week, we’re proud to feature farm-fresh produce from Stony Hill Farm alongside a curated selection of specialty vendors. Browse a variety of offerings including our long time vendor Pickles and Olives, fresh seafood from Scale Fish Market, and prepared foods perfect for dinner. You can also find baked goods, candles, personal care products, and more. You can even take advantage of convenient services like on-site knife sharpening while you shop. On the first and second Wednesdays of each month, enjoy live entertainment that adds to the vibrant, community atmosphere of the market. Whether you’re shopping for the week, grabbing a bite, or simply enjoying the park, the Hamilton Park Farmers Market is a welcoming space to connect with local vendors and neighbors.
